Tejashwi Yadav Accuses CM of Sharing Victim Photo, Violating POCSO Act

Tejashwi Yadav accused Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar of sharing a photograph of a victim from the Jamui case, alleging this action violated the POCSO Act. Yadav stated that the Chief Minister's office posted the picture on the X handle after meeting with the victims of the Jamui incident, and explained the boundaries of the POCSO Act in relation to this.
